title: Korean man's ayahuasca sessions in Peru turn into alien abduction by an 'alien scientist'

tellings.quote: that. He got a full-blown alien experience. He he was taken by this what he described as the alien scientist

plain: A Korean man taking ayahuasca, a psychedelic brew from the Amazon, in Peru in 2024 had what he described as a full-blown alien abduction: he was taken by a being he called "the alien scientist." The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore, who studies psychedelics, passes on the man's account to Michels as part of his argument that these drugs can open contact with real non-human beings.
